In the quaint town of Marigold by the sea, young Ellie and her ever-loyal retriever, Barkley, stumbled upon an ancient map tucked inside a hollow tree. In a small coastal town nestled between dense woods and the vast sea, young Lila finds solace with her intelligent border collie, Finn.
